TEST CASE     : test_happy_path [simple_hash]
============================================================

2    5     z
3    6     w

EXPECTED      : Expected 2 inner join matches for keys 3 and 4.

STATUS        : PASS
EXPLANATION   : Result row count and structure successfully match pandas inner join baseline.
